title: Sesostris Standing
acquisition: Inscription metadata from official Walters art.csv export. Image from Walters donation to Wikimedia Commons. Longer artwork descriptions excluded.
text: On base: The king may guarantee offerings [to the god] Osiris [that he may give] mortuary offerings of bread, beer, oxen, fowl, and incense to Sesostris.
original_inscription_field: [Translation] On base: The king may guarantee offerings [to the god] Osiris [that he may give] mortuary offerings of bread, beer, oxen, fowl, and incense to Sesostris.
geography: Egyptian collection; no exact findspot inferred.
provenance: Dikran Kelekian, New York and Paris [date and mode of acquisition unknown] [said to be from Luxor]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1912, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
coverage_evidence: Museum repeats the same complete base offering formula in both inscription field and description; bracketed supplements retained.
visual_observation: Black-and-white frontal statue photograph. Base text is partly visible but foreshortened; damaged base corner and dark text.
